description.value: Isetta is a beautifully renovated 1962 mid-century modern building on Marine Drive, perched between Howe Sound and the North Shore mountains in West Vancouver. Reopened in 2022 as a destination cafe bistro, it takes its name from the iconic Isetta micro-car, a 1950s Italian-German collaboration. The contact page explicitly calls out Marine Drive as 'a beautiful bicycle ride' and lists Lighthouse Park, Cypress Mountain, and Whytecliff Park as nearby attractions, making it a natural stop for cyclists exploring the Sea-to-Sky corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (15 spaces) at 25m. Total: 15 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and current (Summer 2026 menu, © 2026). The /reserve page explicitly lists 'Bike parking' as an amenity, confirming that required criterion. The menu page uses (V), (VF), and (GS) tags throughout, confirming vegetarian/vegan/GF options. OSM closing time (15:00) contradicts the website (7pm), indicating stale OSM hours data.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (Mo-Su 07:00-15:00) conflicts with website, which shows closing at 7pm (19:00) daily. OSM data appears outdated.
OSM cuisine tag is 'coffee_shop' but the business operates as a full cafe bistro with a substantial food menu and beer/wine service.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible cafe bistro with confirmed bike parking, cyclist-friendly language on the website, and proximity to major cycling routes and destinations on the North Shore.
enrichment_extras.notes: The /reserve page also lists 'ChargePoint EV Charging' and 'Wheelchair accessible (off Marine Drive)' and 'Beer & Wine' as amenities. ChargePoint is car-oriented EV charging and is not confirmed as e-bike compatible, so e-bike charging is left null.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu uses (V) vegetarian, (VF) vegan-friendly, and (GS) gluten-sensitive tags across multiple items including Avocado Toast, Caponata & Grits, Field Greens, and Truffle Fries

wow_evidence: contact page explicitly calls out Marine Drive as 'a beautiful bicycle ride' ... 'Bike parking' listed as an amenity
